Two Weights are == to each other only when both their unit and their amount are equal; two Weights with different units are never == to each other, even when their amounts happen to match. Comparing two Weights of different units with <, <=, >, or >=, sorting an array that mixes units, or calling clamp or between? with a bound of a different unit, raises ArgumentError rather than silently producing some ordering.
